rv.q: The laughs never stop coming in this razor-sharp production.

There’s good work, too, from Dave Hearn as Max, who has only been cast because his uncle put up the money; Nancy Wallinger as Annie, a multiple quick-change failure, and Ellie Morris as the stagefright-afflicted Lucy, who believes in fairies. It’s formulaic, but it delivers.
If you're looking for a feel-good evening of solid gold comedy this is the show for you. Don't miss it!
